usedFor: Amazon Seller Central holds orders and Kit holds subscribers, and “Create or Update Subscriber” adds a subscriber for each order.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in Kit
bestTemplate.why: A new order creates or updates the subscriber, so your email list follows what customers actually bought.

watchOut: “New Order Created” is polling, so subscribers appear after a scheduled check, not the moment an order lands.
